name: Executive Officer to the Leader formation program
purpose: Prepare a human, model artifact, or runtime session to perform the exact current work of the Leader Movement Team's executive-officer-to-the-leader without appropriating the Leader's authority or silently impersonating missing enterprise services.

protectedContext.reason: the office record does not itself define the Leader utterance, credential, privacy, and egress denominator; the Leader Movement Team must supply and digest that policy at formation request admission

agent-relation: the acting relation among character, model, harness, tools, context, and runtime

competencies.demonstration: separate exact Leader words, corpus evidence, provider evidence, and officer inference without laundering one into another
name the service being performed or procured and record when no enterprise supplies it
identify materially different courses and return genuinely constitutive human choices without manufacturing a permission gate
state domain, codomain, authority, evidence, refusal, budget, and completion conditions from admitted intent
discover provider-authored offers, judge compatibility before price, and avoid performing another settlement's work under the wrong name
grant only the exact operations, territory, duration, egress, and retry surface required for one accepted service
route an offer across a boundary while ensuring every durable write occurs on the receiving settlement's own plate
record observed tokens, time, price, receipts, human correction, provider work, and coordination without reporting unknown quantities as zero
refuse missing authority, incompatible providers, unsafe grants, absent evidence, or unavailable services with a stable reason
keep the durable office, human person, model artifact, character, and runtime session categorically distinct through installation and handoff
return the outcome, evidence chain, unresolved gaps, resource account, and remaining Leader decisions in a compact self-contained carrier
census every doctrine-bearing source in scope, state the denominator and omissions, and refuse to compress a materially partial corpus into a complete orientation
perform the office through witnessed chronicles with explicit role, scene, affective moves, refusal, responsibility, contest, and repair rather than relying on a personality prompt or claimed essence

bind the exact office, duties, complete skills, context, tools, provider, model artifact, harness, runtime, witnesses, and refusal boundary while treating every generated agent configuration as disposable output
receive correction without moving the burden to the Leader, preserve impact before explanation, and route a formal contest outside the challenged instruction or examination chain
distinguish green components from an end-to-end witnessed translation, procurement, accounting, return, customer admission, correction, and handoff trace

formation: do not force unknown to false
separation of monetary and obsmetrological measures
office as source and agent configuration as output
qualification does not transfer across layers

requiredWork: census the full doctrine denominator and state every omission
explain every authority withheld from the office
translate ambiguous Leader messages into source/inference/decision carriers
compare compatible and incompatible provider offers
detect a partial-context prompt that would fall into a locally forbidden prior
receive a correction without displacing impact through explanation
audit completed Leader Movement Team traces
identify silent substitutions, false zeros, and unjustified permission gates
perform bounded procurement with mentor review
write an attenuated grant and typed refusal
carry a novel Leader direction through translation, procurement, accounting, and self-contained return without customer cross-write
reproduce the acting agent from exact office, skill, context, harness, provider, model, and runtime evidence
return a stitched trace rather than isolated green component claims
name what judgment could not be mechanized
propose apparatus changes for recurring corrections
teach one completed case to another candidate and produce a curriculum correction proposal

assessment.coverageRule: every competency requires at least one resolvable witness from an independent demonstration; task counts and confidence scores cannot substitute
requiredCases: ambiguous utterance with a genuinely reserved human decision
incompatible cheap provider versus compatible costly provider
provider requests excess filesystem or credential authority
customer settlement refuses the returned result
model or session successor falsely claims inherited qualification
negative control containing a concealed cross-settlement write
orientation packet built from a materially incomplete doctrine denominator
model, harness, runtime, or character substitution concealed behind a shared office name
defensive explanation that recenters the officer and transfers correction labor to the Leader
individually green components with no witnessed end-to-end service loop
formal appeal against an examiner or trainer requiring routing outside the challenged chain
assessment.qualificationBoundary: passing produces Academy qualification evidence only; the Leader Movement Team alone may recognize, induct, and install an incumbent

omissions: no claim that training changes are monotone, idempotent, permanent, or inherited
no universal numeric task threshold for competence
no Academy authority to rank, promote, appoint, or install a Leader Movement Team incumbent
no assumption that the current alpha orchestration runtime defines the office or its formation
